utilities.title: Utilities
utilities.intro: Review the downloaded library. No operation deletes anything.

operation.replaygain: Recompute the ReplayGain of the whole library
operation.relocate: Move the files to the template names, without retagging
operation.check_files: Check the files are still on disk
operation.complete_artists: Refresh artist profiles (image, description and audience)
operation.lyrics: Look up missing lyrics (LRCLIB and YouTube Music)
operation.complete_albums: Complete albums with their missing tracks (queries YouTube Music)

utilities.conflict: Retagging and ReplayGain do not go in the same run as relocating: let Navidrome scan in between.

summary.title: Summary
summary.replaygain: ReplayGain: {albums} albums and {files} files. Failed albums: {failed}.
summary.relocate: Files moved: {moved}. Already in place: {unchanged}. Failed: {failed}.
summary.lyrics: Lyrics saved: {found}. Not found: {not_found}. No answer: {failed}.
summary.complete_albums: Albums checked: {albums}. Tracks added: {tracks} ({reused_recordings} with an already known recording). No answer from YouTube Music: {errors}.
